Santa Clara University · Yelping Hand Project

Fostering
Belonging

We are building a living database of places, events, food, activities and more around campus — to encourage SCU students to explore belonging beyond our campus borders, be inspired to try something new, and create connections by interacting with people in the community. In the process, we aim to strengthen the bonds between friends.

Our Mission

Three goals driving everything we do

🌎

Explore Beyond Campus

SCU sits at the heart of Silicon Valley — one of the most vibrant, culturally rich regions in the world. We want every student to feel empowered to step off campus and discover what’s right outside their door.

🤝

Connect with Community

Belonging isn’t just about your dorm hall. By interacting with local vendors, neighbors, and people from all walks of life, students build a richer, more grounded sense of home.

💛

Strengthen Friendships

Shared experiences are the foundation of lasting bonds. Whether it’s a hike through the Redwoods or a late-night Santana Row walk, doing something together creates memories that stick.
